The '''Gendrah-Narvin system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]].

==History==
Known for harboring [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] activity, the system became a target for the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. Within two years prior to the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] visited the system aboard the [[Tantive IV/Legends|''Tantive IV'']] to secretly aid the Rebels located there.<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref>
